A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 20-page versions of the same ULEE paper. The text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A.1–A.4 support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Sections 4.3.1–4.3.5 report original exploration, adaptation, fine-tuning, and generalization experiments, with results in Figures 2–5 and Table 1.

after.justification: The same original experimental results are retained in Sections 4.3.1–4.3.5, Figures 2–5, and Table 1.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same in-context policy, adversarial goal search, bounded goal sampling, and difficulty predictor. The architecture and training procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use 4Rooms-Trivial, 4Rooms-Small, and 6Rooms-Small, plus the same 14 MiniGrid tasks in Table 1. No training or evaluation coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: Random-policy, DIAYN, PPO, RND, and RL2 baselines retain the same participation in their corresponding comparisons. The evaluated ULEE variants are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A.2 retain identical data splits, training budgets, model settings, episode horizons, sample sizes, metrics, and evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: The goal-search, sampling, single-episode-difficulty, and goal-mapping comparisons are unchanged. Appendix A.2.5 retains the same hyperparameter investigations and stability observations.

E5.justification: Both versions report four training seeds, individual-seed exploration curves, and standard deviations for return results. The auxiliary seed procedure and limited tuning-run disclosures in Appendix A.2 are unchanged.

E6.justification: Figures 2–5 contain identical plot images, and Table 1 retains every numerical result. The main-text findings and appendix observations are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical setting, objectives, difficulty definition, and Equations 1–5 are unchanged. Appendix A.3 retains the same post-adaptation learning-progress formulation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about exploration, adaptation, transfer, and fine-tuning. The added code link does not alter these claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of curriculum components and goal mappings, difficulties on challenging tasks, tuning limitations, and future directions are retained without substantive revision.

D1.justification: The v2 abstract adds an explicit, clickable GitHub repository link. V1 states that code is open-sourced but supplies no repository link. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, and experimental instructions remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and positioning against prior curriculum-learning and unsupervised meta-learning methods are unchanged, including the discussion in Appendix A.3.

P1.justification: V2 adds a code-access sentence to the abstract and changes the running header from 'To appear' to 'Published' at ICLR 2026. The remaining prose and section order are unchanged.

P2.justification: Spacing and pagination shift content: Algorithm 1 moves from page 14 to 15, and Table 2 from page 17 to 18. Figures and tables retain their content, captions, and display structure.

improvement.justification: V2 supplies the concrete code location missing from v1's open-source statement, modestly improving reproducibility documentation. The scientific content, evidence, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall benefit is limited.
